notes: Columns: frequency_Hz; nominal, median, p5, p10, p90, p95, min, max in ohm; nominal, median, p5, p95, min, max of the phase in degrees; runs (successful Monte Carlo runs); shading (validity of the nominal solve: 0 none, 1 light, 2 dark; docs/netlist.md).
